articles.title: Governo estima que projeto que prevê perdão a dívidas de MEIs terá impacto de R$ 3 bilhões em três anos | G1
articles.standfirst: Proposta faz parte de pacote de medidas voltadas aos pequenos negócios lançado pelo governo federal nesta terça-feira (13), a 12 dias do segundo turno das eleições.
articles.summary: Proposta faz parte de pacote de medidas voltadas aos pequenos negócios lançado pelo governo federal nesta terça-feira (13), a 12 dias do segundo turno das eleições.
articles.body:
A equipe econômica do governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) estima que o Projeto de Lei Complementar (PLP) que prevê o perdão de dívidas de Microempreendedores Individuais (MEIs) inscritas na Dívida Ativa da União terá impacto de R$ 3 bilhões em três anos .

A proposta faz parte do pacote de medidas voltadas aos pequenos negócios anunciado pelo governo federal nesta terça-feira (13) , a 12 dias do segundo turno das eleições. O texto ainda depende de aprovação do Congresso Nacional.

Impacto fiscal da proposta que prevê perdão a dívidas de MEIs

Ao todo, segundo o governo, o projeto prevê o perdão integral de R$ 12,6 bilhões em dívidas de cerca de 3,6 milhões de MEIs.

Serão abrangidos débitos da União inscritos em Dívida Ativa até 13 de outubro de 2026, relativos às contribuições devidas pelos microempreendedores, além de juros, multas e encargos legais.

De acordo com o governo, quase 86% do estoque dessas dívidas, o equivalente à cerca de R$ 11 bilhões, é considerado de difícil ou impossível recuperação.

A equipe econômica argumenta que manter a cobrança desse volume de débitos gera custos administrativos sem garantia de que os valores serão efetivamente recuperados.

"Manter a cobrança desse volume de dívidas gera altos custos administrativos para o governo, sem a garantia de que o dinheiro será efetivamente arrecadado. Com o perdão, o governo passa a focar nas dívidas com maior chance de recuperação, enquanto os microempreendedores ganham um alívio financeiro para investir em seus próprios negócios e voltar a pagar os tributos em dia", diz o governo, em nota.

Para manter o perdão, o microempreendedor terá de pagar em dia suas contribuições mensais nos seis meses seguintes ao início da vigência da lei.

Em outra frente, o governo definiu "salvaguardas" para delimitar os efeitos da medida .

Com isso, quem já pagou a dívida antes da entrada em vigor da lei não terá direito à devolução ou compensação dos valores.

Garantias vinculadas também a débitos que não forem perdoados poderão ser mantidas na parcela necessária para cobrir essas dívidas. O projeto também estabelece que o encerramento de processos devido ao perdão não poderá, por si só, gerar cobrança de honorários advocatícios do beneficiário.

articles.title: Campo Grande veta suspensão de descontos do Master em folha  | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão foi publicada no Diário Oficial; prefeitura aponta inconstitucionalidade da proposta, enquanto Procon registra reclamações de servidores sobre descontos relacionados ao cartão.
articles.summary: Decisão foi publicada no Diário Oficial; prefeitura aponta inconstitucionalidade da proposta, enquanto Procon registra reclamações de servidores sobre descontos relacionados
articles.body:
A Prefeitura de Campo Grande , vetou integralmente o projeto de lei que previa a suspensão de descontos em folha de pagamento de servidores municipais relacionados ao Banco Master S.A., CredCesta e a empresas ligadas às operações. A proposta também estabelecia exigências para a apresentação de contratos e demonstrativos das dívidas.

O veto da prefeita Adriane Lopes (PP) foi publicado em edição extra do Diário Oficial de Campo Grande (Diogrande), nesta terça-feira (13). O veto ocorre em meio a queixas de servidores que relatam cobranças que consideram indevidas relacionadas ao CredCesta, inclusive após a quitação do cartão.

O Projeto de Lei nº 12.497/2026, aprovado pela Câmara Municipal em setembro, previa a suspensão de descontos referentes a operações de cartão de crédito consignado, cartão benefício, Reserva de Margem Consignável (RMC), Reserva de Cartão Consignado (RCC) e empréstimos consignados vinculados ao Banco Master, ao CredCesta e a empresas relacionadas.

🔎O CredCesta é um cartão de crédito operado pela empresa PKL One e associado a operações vinculadas ao Banco Master. O produto é oferecido a servidores públicos e permite, entre outras funcionalidades, sacar parte do limite de crédito disponibilizado, com o valor devido sujeito às condições contratuais. O cartão também oferece benefícios adicionais, como assistência funeral, seguro de vida e telemedicina, conforme as condições do serviço.

🔎🔎 O Banco Master cresceu oferecendo CDBs com rendimentos muito acima dos praticados pelo mercado, atraindo investidores com a garantia do Fundo Garantidor de Créditos (FGC), que cobre até R$ 250 mil por investidor, conforme as regras do fundo. O banco acumulou um passivo bilionário e mantinha ativos de baixa liquidez, como precatórios e participações em empresas em dificuldades, o que aumentou as preocupações sobre sua saúde financeira.

🔎🔎🔎Em novembro de 2025, o Banco Central determinou a liquidação extrajudicial do Banco Master, encerrando suas atividades. Nesse processo, um liquidante assume o controle da instituição, organiza a venda de bens e o pagamento dos credores conforme a ordem prevista em lei.

A decisão do Executivo municipal foi fundamentada em pareceres da Procuradoria-Geral do Município (PGM) e da Secretaria Municipal da Fazenda (Sefaz), além de manifestação anterior da Procuradoria da Câmara Municipal.

Segundo os órgãos jurídicos, a proposta invadia a competência legislativa privativa da União para tratar de direito civil, contratos bancários e política de crédito, conforme o artigo 22, incisos I e VII, da Constituição Federal.

A fundamentação também citou decisões do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) que consideraram inconstitucionais leis estaduais que determinavam a suspensão genérica de descontos consignados em folha de pagamento, por interferirem em contratos privados.

Os pareceres apontaram ainda que interromper os descontos em folha não significa cancelar as dívidas nem suspender automaticamente a cobrança de juros e outros encargos previstos nos contratos.

Prefeitura de Campo Grande (MS). — Foto: Caio Tumelero/TV Morena

Na avaliação da prefeitura, a medida poderia expor os servidores a cobranças diretas, juros por atraso e eventual inclusão em cadastros de inadimplentes.

O município também destacou que eventuais transferências de carteiras de crédito para outras instituições financeiras precisam ser analisadas administrativamente. Segundo a justificativa do veto, decisões judiciais relacionadas a casos específicos não autorizam, por si só, a suspensão generalizada dos descontos por meio de uma lei municipal.

A prefeitura considerou inviável vetar apenas parte do projeto. A fiscalização de possíveis irregularidades e o cumprimento de ordens judiciais, conforme o Executivo, continuam possíveis pelos procedimentos administrativos e judiciais cabíveis.

A proposta aprovada pelos vereadores previa a suspensão dos descontos até que fossem apresentados aos servidores o contrato integral, o saldo devedor atualizado e a memória de cálculo da dívida.

O texto também exigia a comprovação da legitimidade da instituição responsável pela operação e da regularidade da consignação junto à prefeitura. Em caso de irregularidades, ausência de documentação ou falta de autorização para o desconto, o município poderia cancelar a consignação e adotar as medidas cabíveis.

Durante a tramitação, a Procuradoria-Geral do Município já havia emitido parecer contrário à proposta, sob o argumento de que a regulamentação de matérias relacionadas ao direito civil e à política de crédito é de competência da União.

Entre janeiro a setembro de 2026, o Procon de Mato Grosso do Sul atendeu 32 servidores em casos relacionados a descontos considerados indevidos envolvendo o CredCesta, do Banco Master. Desse total, oito atendimentos resultaram em registros de reclamação.

Cobranças por serviços não contratados ou por dívidas já quitadas violam o Código de Defesa do Consumidor e podem configurar práticas abusivas e enriquecimento ilícito.

Nessas situações, consumidoras e consumidores podem solicitar a suspensão dos descontos em folha de pagamento junto ao setor de Recursos Humanos, pedir a restituição em dobro dos valores cobrados e pagos indevidamente e buscar judicialmente indenização por danos morais, especialmente em casos de comprometimento da renda ou de restrições no CPF.

Servidores que tiverem dúvidas ou identificarem possíveis irregularidades nos descontos podem procurar o Procon de Mato Grosso do Sul pelo site ou em uma das unidades de atendimento presencial.

Também é possível registrar uma reclamação no Banco Central, pelo site ou pelo telefone 145. No caso de descontos aplicados a benefícios do INSS, a orientação é procurar o próprio instituto, pelo site ou pelo telefone 135.

articles.title: Emissoras de rádio e TV se reúnem na República Dominicana para discutir futuro da produção audiovisual nas Américas | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento celebra os 80 anos da Associação Internacional de Radiodifusão (AIR), que representa emissoras de rádio e TV das Américas do Norte, Central e do Sul.
articles.summary: Evento celebra os 80 anos da Associação Internacional de Radiodifusão (AIR), que representa emissoras de rádio e TV das Américas do Norte, Central e do Sul.
articles.body:
Um encontro em Santo Domingo, capital da República Dominicana, reúne representantes de emissoras de rádio e televisão, produtores de conteúdo e operadoras de TV paga para debater os temas que vão redefinir a produção audiovisual nos próximos anos.

A Cúpula da Indústria Audiovisual das Américas, realizada entre terça e quarta-feira (14), celebra os 80 anos da Associação Internacional de Radiodifusão (AIR), que representa 17 mil emissoras comerciais de rádio e TV das Américas do Norte, Central e do Sul e é presidida desde 2023 por Paulo Tonet Camargo, vice-presidente institucional da ABERT (Associação Brasileira de Emissoras de Rádio e Televisão) e vice-presidente de Relações Institucionais do Grupo Globo.

Entre os temas em debate estão a nova geração da TV conectada; o protagonismo da TV aberta e o consumo de conteúdo no celular; métricas de audiência no ecossistema multiplataforma; proteção de conteúdos na era digital e combate à pirataria; inteligência artificial e novos desafios da indústria.

Segundo Tonet, o encontro "mostra a disposição da indústria de olhar para o futuro, e olhar para o futuro com uma nova concepção".

"A AIR assenta o seu futuro em três bases: liberdade, porque a liberdade de expressão é a nossa base de existência; responsabilidade, porque temos responsabilidade sobre os conteúdos de informação e entretenimento que distribuímos; e sustentabilidade, porque a indústria, para poder fornecer tudo isso às sociedades onde trabalhamos, precisa ser sustentável."

Reunião do Conselho Diretivo da AIR em Santo Domingo, na República Dominicana — Foto: AIR/Adora/Reprodução

Tonet afirma que é essencial somar esforços em um grande fórum para discutir os temas que são fundamentais para o futuro e o desenvolvimento dos negócios na região.

"Reunir as três Américas para discutir os grandes temas da indústria audiovisual é realmente importante, porque a adoção de modelos tecnológicos de métricas de audiência, de proeminência e de combate à pirataria é algo que precisamos fazer de maneira continental. Nenhum país, nenhuma empresa, consegue fazer isso isoladamente", diz.

Flávio Lara Resende, vice-presidente jurídico da AIR e vice-presidente institucional da ABERT, destaca a importância do Brasil para o setor.

"É extremamente importante porque o Brasil lidera nas três Américas a produção de conteúdo jornalístico e de entretenimento, seja no rádio, seja na televisão. Então, você reunir aqui radiodifusores de diversos países é extremamente importante para que a gente possa ter uma definição do que será o futuro da radiofusão nas três Américas, principalmente na televisão aberta."

A Associação Internacional de Radiodifusão celebra 80 anos de trabalho permanente em defesa da liberdade de expressão e da radiodifusão livre, privada e independente nas Américas.

Desde sua criação, em 1946, a AIR tem acompanhado as profundas transformações tecnológicas, sociais e econômicas, defendendo a independência dos meios de comunicação, o pluralismo, a segurança jurídica e o direito de todas as pessoas a buscar, receber e difundir informações e opiniões.

"A acelerada transformação tecnológica, as novas formas de produção e distribuição de conteúdos, o desenvolvimento da IA, a concorrência das grandes plataformas digitais, a pirataria e os desafios para a sustentabilidade dos meios de comunicação configuram um cenário profundamente diferente", diz a AIR em um comunicado que celebra seus 80 anos.

"Diante dessas mudanças, a AIR renova seu compromisso de representar e defender a radiodifusão e de promover as condições necessárias para que os meios e os criadores de conteúdos possam continuar inovando, crescendo e cumprindo sua indispensável função a serviço da sociedade."

articles.title: Bumble encontra um novo par: aplicativo de namoro é vendido por R$ 6,5 bilhões | G1
articles.standfirst: Acordo prevê pagamento de US$ 6,05 por ação, e fundadora do aplicativo continuará envolvida no negócio após a compra pela Ithaca Holdings.
articles.summary: Acordo prevê pagamento de US$ 6,05 por ação, e fundadora do aplicativo continuará envolvida no negócio após a compra pela Ithaca Holdings.
articles.body:
Bumble é vendida por US$ 1,3 bilhão e fundadora seguirá à frente do aplicativo. — Foto: Divulgação/Bumble

O aplicativo de relacionamentos Bumble anunciou nesta terça-feira (13) um acordo para ser comprado pela Ithaca Holdings por US$ 1,3 bilhão (R$ 6,5 bilhões), em uma operação integralmente em dinheiro.

Com a conclusão do negócio, a empresa deixará de ter ações negociadas na bolsa e passará a ser uma companhia de capital fechado.

Pelo acordo, os acionistas do Bumble receberão US$ 6,05 por ação .

O valor representa um prêmio de aproximadamente 138% em relação ao preço de fechamento das ações na última sexta-feira (9) e de 119% sobre a média ponderada pelo volume negociado nos 30 dias anteriores à mesma data.

A fundadora e atual diretora-executiva do Bumble, Whitney Wolfe Herd, continuará envolvida na companhia após a conclusão da operação. Ravi Gupta e John Hegeman, cofundadores e co-diretores-executivos da Ithaca Holdings, assumirão o comando do aplicativo e trabalharão em conjunto com Wolfe Herd.

Segundo o comunicado, a Ithaca pretende ampliar a atuação do Bumble e investir no desenvolvimento do negócio. A empresa afirma que busca combinar tecnologias avançadas com experiência em gestão para renovar empresas e ampliar seu potencial de longo prazo.

O Bumble continuará operando com escritórios em Londres , Austin e Nova York , e a expectativa é que sua sede permaneça em Austin , nos Estados Unidos.

O acordo foi aprovado por unanimidade pelo conselho de administração do Bumble, com exceção de Wolfe Herd, que se declarou impedida de participar das discussões e da votação sobre a operação.

Antes da decisão, um comitê independente do conselho, assessorado por especialistas jurídicos e financeiros, avaliou diferentes alternativas estratégicas para a empresa. O grupo concluiu que a proposta da Ithaca era a melhor opção para os acionistas e recomendou a aprovação do negócio.

Após a assinatura do acordo, empresas ligadas à gestora Blackstone e Wolfe Herd também aprovaram a operação por meio de um consentimento por escrito dos acionistas, garantindo a aprovação societária necessária, segundo o comunicado.

A presidente do conselho do Bumble e do comitê independente, Ann Mather, afirmou que o grupo analisou as alternativas disponíveis com o objetivo de maximizar o valor para os acionistas .

articles.title: Mais de 26 milhões de brasileiros têm dinheiro esquecido em instituições financeiras; saiba como consultar e não cair em golpes | G1
articles.standfirst: É importante ficar atento para não cair em golpes: a liberação do dinheiro é de graça, o Banco Central não envia links e nem entra em contato.
articles.summary: É importante ficar atento para não cair em golpes: a liberação do dinheiro é de graça, o Banco Central não envia links e nem entra em contato.
articles.body:
O Banco Central divulgou nesta terça-feira (13) um novo balanço do dinheiro esquecido em instituições financeiras. Ao todo, são quase R$ 6 bilhões .

O que você faria se descobrisse que tem dinheiro a receber?

“Seria muito útil no meu dia a dia, com as compras”, diz a aposentada Maria Luzia Miranda.

“Eu ia pagar as minhas dívidas, porque dívida eu tenho demais”, conta a auxiliar de cozinha Marisete Pereira de Jesus.

Mais de 26 milhões de brasileiros e empresas têm quantias esquecidas em bancos, consórcios e outras instituições. São R$ 5,8 bilhões aguardando pelos donos. A maioria dos beneficiários tem direito a embolsar até R$ 10. Para o restante, o valor do resgate é maior e pode ultrapassar R$ 1 mil.

O economista Felipe Leroy explica que, em muitos casos, esse dinheiro inesperado vem de algum saldo que ficou parado depois do encerramento de uma conta.

“Os bancos normalmente trabalham com mecanismos de aplicações automáticas. Então, você olha para sua conta e o saldo está zerado, é muito comum, mas você tem ali um dinheiro em uma aplicação que é em uma segunda conta. Dinheiro também funciona como um colchão de reserva para o futuro, para amortizar um possível imprevisto”, afirma o economista Felipe Leroy.

Mais de 26 milhões de brasileiros têm dinheiro esquecido em instituições financeiras — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Para você descobrir se tem dinheiro esquecido, o único meio é pelo site do Banco Central. Basta digitar o CPF e a data de nascimento ou o CNPJ e a data de abertura da empresa. A reportagem do g1 explica o passo a passo para solicitar o resgate .

É importante ficar atento para não cair em golpes: a liberação do dinheiro é de graça, o Banco Central não envia links e nem entra em contato. Somente a instituição que vai fazer o pagamento pode acionar o beneficiário, mas ela nunca vai pedir senha.

“É um direito nosso. Então, a gente, no caso, trabalha para isso. Se tem dinheiro lá, então é direito nosso buscar”, diz o promotor de vendas Pablo Santana.

articles.title: Precio de la luz por horas hoy, miércoles 14 de octubre: cuándo es más barata y más cara
articles.standfirst: El precio de la luz se encarece notablemente este miércoles
articles.summary: El precio de la luz se encarece notablemente este miércoles
articles.body: El precio medio de la electricidad en España para hoy, miércoles, se sitúa en 186,45 €/MWh, lo que representa un incremento de 19,82 € respecto al día anterior, que cerró en 166,63 €/MWh. Esta subida continua a lo largo de la semana, generando preocupación entre los consumidores. A medida que avanza el día, se analizarán las horas más caras y más baratas para optimizar el consumo. Los precios de la luz alcanzan su punto más alto en las franjas horarias entre las 19:00 y las 21:00, donde se concentran los valores más elevados. Durante este periodo, el precio de la energía supera los 288.34 €/MWh, alcanzando un máximo de 293.39 €/MWh a las 20:00. Este bloque continuo de horas caras representa un desafío significativo para los consumidores, quienes deben ajustar su consumo para evitar tarifas excesivas. La luz es más barata entre la madrugada y la mañana temprana, especialmente entre las 12:00 y las 16:00, donde se pueden encontrar las tarifas más bajas. Durante este periodo, las franjas horarias destacadas son 12:00 - 13:00 (60.19 €/MWh), 13:00 - 14:00 (57.80 €/MWh), 14:00 - 15:00 (57.72 €/MWh) y 15:00 - 16:00 (57.80 €/MWh), ofreciendo una ventana amplia de precios bajos que proporciona excelentes oportunidades de ahorro. En contraste, los picos de precios se concentran entre las 19:00 - 20:00 (288.34 €/MWh) y 20:00 - 21:00 (293.39 €/MWh), sugiriendo que evitar estas horas puede resultar en significativos ahorros. En el análisis de las franjas horarias de hoy, destaca una elevada concentración de precios altos durante las horas pico de la tarde y noche, lo que sugiere que los consumidores deben estar especialmente atentos para gestionar su consumo y evitar facturas elevadas. A continuación, se presenta la tabla con los precios horarios.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon: 'No succession transition or timeline underway'
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs said Tuesday that third quarter profits rose 29% from a year earlier as its Wall Street trading and dealmaking businesses continued to deliver...
articles.body:
Goldman Sachs ( GS ) said Tuesday that third quarter profits rose 29% from a year earlier as its Wall Street trading and dealmaking businesses continued to deliver solid results despite cooling from a record second quarter.

The bank reported $5.29 billion in net earnings, or $17.01 per share, far exceeding the $13.50 per share forecast by analysts.

Total net revenue increased 23% to $18.7 billion, while analysts expected $16.4 billion.

Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon described the bank's third quarter backdrop as "a complicated operating environment" in a statement accompanying the earnings release.

Later, on a conference call with analysts, Solomon pushed back against recent reports that a leadership change is underway at the bank.

"There is no succession transition or timeline underway at Goldman Sachs," Solomon said, adding that he is "really enjoying the job."

His comments followed a Wall Street Journal report that Goldman's board discussed a plan for Solomon to step down as soon as 2027 or in 2028, potentially making way for his longtime deputy, John Waldron.

Goldman Sachs' stock was up less than 1% midday.

This price reflects trading activity during the overnight session on the Blue Ocean ATS, available 8 PM to 4 AM ET, Sunday through Thursday, when regular markets are closed.

Goldman's results come after Wall Street executives cautioned that the trading boom that fueled record revenues earlier this year would be difficult to sustain.

The company said revenue across its equities and fixed-income trading divisions totaled $9.9 billion, driven by a 96% jump in revenue from its equities financing business.

The total haul far exceeded the $8.8 billion analysts projected, though it was still short of the record $12 billion the bank earned in the previous quarter. Revenue from Goldman's fixed income, currencies, and commodities group fell slightly from a year earlier.

Investment banking fees rose 21% over the same period to $3.22 billion, driven by a jump in revenues from its M&A advisory unit and equity underwriting business. Advisory revenue reached a record $1.65 billion.

The results come as the country's biggest banks enter a somewhat delicate earnings season with investors watching for clues that higher borrowing costs could temper the extraordinary growth Wall Street saw earlier in the year.

Goldman's third quarter print also included charitable contributions that reduced earnings by approximately $1 per share, along with higher-than-expected provisions for credit losses of $368 million, largely reflecting impairments on wholesale loans.

The bank also reported markdowns tied to its Apple Card loan portfolio, contributing to a 72% decline in revenue from its Platform Solutions business. Goldman is in the process of offloading its Apple ( AAPL ) credit card portfolio to JPMorgan Chase ( JPM ).

articles.title: María Cristina Buendía, notaria, explica qué ocurre cuando una persona se marcha a vivir a una residencia: “Queda exenta de la ganancia patrimonial en el IRPF”
articles.standfirst: La experta aclara la problemática de este cambio tan importante
articles.summary: La experta aclara la problemática de este cambio tan importante
articles.body: Hay decisiones en la vida de una persona que pueden marcar un antes y un después. Una de ellas es irse a vivir a una residencia al cumplir una edad avanzada y esto, en ocasiones, deriva en asuntos a resolver, como por ejemplo la venta del inmueble una vez que se abandona. Lo cierto es que existen ciertas dudas que ahora la experta María Cristina Buendía ha querido resolver. La notaria, en una de sus últimas publicaciones, ha explicado qué ocurre cuando, por ejemplo, “tu padre, madre o abuelo lleva años viviendo en una residencia y ha llegado el momento de vender su casa”. “Aunque hayan pasado varios años desde que dejó de vivir en ella, e incluso aunque la vivienda haya estado alquilada durante ese tiempo, puede seguir conservando la consideración de vivienda habitual a efectos de aplicar la exención de la ganancia patrimonial en el IRPF”, aclara Buendía, que indica que esta previsión “afecta a mayores de 65 años que se hayan trasladado por razón de edad a una residencia”. Asimismo, puede contemplar otros casos, como los de “gran dependencia o dependencia severa”, así como el “traslado al domicilio de familiares hasta tercer grado, tanto por consanguinidad como por afinidad”. Esto, según la notaria, es una cuestión “especialmente importante” antes de decidir poner a la venta este inmueble. Pese a esto, María Cristina Buendía aconseja revisar cada caso de manera individual, ya que debe someterse a un análisis “específico” para comprobar si, efectivamente, este tipo de consideraciones van a afectar y de qué manera. En cualquier caso, la experta da con una de las claves más importantes a tener en cuenta, de forma general, en estos casos en que una persona se marcha a vivir a una residencia.

articles.title: Why BlackRock is suddenly more bearish on stocks
articles.summary: When BlackRock gets more bearish on stocks, it's a red flag to toss onto the investing field.
articles.body:
When BlackRock ( BLK ) gets more bearish on stocks, it's a red flag to toss onto the investing field.

The world's largest asset manager on Tuesday upgraded its views on US Treasurys , preferring short-term bonds as higher yields improve potential. The research was conducted by BlackRock's Jean Boivin, Rick Rieder, and Wei Li.

In turn, the team downgraded its views on US stocks to Neutral.

"Higher yields and potentially excessive Fed tightening expectations create room to unwind our U.S. Treasury underweight — a mainstay for most of the last six years," BlackRock's team said. "We upgrade Treasuries, favoring short-term bonds. In turn, we take profits: downgrading U.S. equities to neutral to manage potential volatility around the AI buildout."

They remain optimistic on AI stocks , however, despite the fresh concerns.

"We retain our conviction in AI fundamentals and preference for AI within U.S. equities," the strategists added.

BlackRock's downgrade in stocks comes at a precarious time for the market's non-AI areas. Sell-offs have gained steam amid the push higher in US Treasury yields , which has raised the cost of capital for companies that may not be growing as fast as AI companies.

About 84% of S&P 500 ( ^GSPC ) stocks are now trading at least 10% below their all-time highs, according to new analysis from the Kobeissi Letter .

What's more, 59% of S&P 500 stocks are down at least 20% from their highs, 41% are down more than 30%, and 17% are off by more than 50%.

"I would say [it's] not a crisis but an eye-opener, and it's something I think you've got to think about," Rieder said about the move in yields on Sozzi Unleashed in late September.

Brian Sozzi is Yahoo Finance's Executive Editor, host of the Sozzi Unleashed morning show and the Power Players with Brian Sozzi podcast, and a member of Yahoo Finance's editorial leadership team. Follow Sozzi on X @BrianSozzi , Instagram , and LinkedIn . Tips on stories? Email brian.sozzi@yahoofinance.com.

articles.title: Bumble bought for $1.3bn in 'bet on the future of humanity'
articles.summary: The dating app which recently ditched its "women-first" chat rule has been bought by an investment firm.
articles.body:
Dating app Bumble has been bought for $1.3bn (£980m) in what the new owners called "a bet on the future of humanity".

Investment firm Ithaca Holdings is taking over the loss-making firm and it directors, Ravi Gupta and John Hegeman, will become co-chief executives of the company which once differentiated itself by having a "women-first" chat rule.

Bumble ditched the rule in August this year.

Whitney Wolfe Herd, Bumble's founder and current chief executive, said she would remain "actively involved" with the business she set up 12 years ago.

While it is unclear what Wolfe Herd's role at the dating app will be, she said she will work closely with the new owners.

Gupta and Hegeman said they wanted to use technology to "renew and accelerate businesses...in a world transformed by AI".

They said: "Technology should work in service of our deepest source of fulfillment, human connection and this investment is a bet on the future of humanity."

This contrasts with a recent debate over the safety of AI, with some experts claiming the speed of its development threatens the future of humanity .

Bumble's share price has soared as news of the deal began to emerge. The jump lifted its company valuation to over $580m but that is still far below a peak of more than $14bn it reached after it floated the business on the Nasdaq stock index in 2021 .

Since becoming a public company, it has made an annual pre-tax profit only once, in 2023.

In the following two years, it reported steep losses, though during that period Bumble had been working to incorporate new technology, including AI, into its app.

Its chief executive in 2024, Lidiane Jones, told the BBC she believed AI had "exciting potential" in dating apps related to safety, and Bumble had been looking at research that found Gen Z and milliennials were interested in AI assistance with creating profiles.

This year, the dating app unveiled several new AI features, including profile guidance to help people create dating profiles.

Bumble was launched in 2014 by Wolfe Herd who built the brand around a distinctive feature that only allowed women to initiate conversations with matches.

It recently abandoned that rule , prompting debate among users over whether the app had lost what set it apart from rivals.

"Today, our community is asking for more flexibility, less pressure, and more opportunities to create real, meaningful connections and that is what this new experience provides," Wolfe Herd said in August.

Dating apps like Bumble have come under pressure in recent years as some younger users have grown disillusioned with browsing for dates.

articles.title: Anthropic warns AI could 'self-replicate' across smart home devices, become 'challenging' to shut down
articles.summary: Anthropic says that AI models could soon self-replicate across smart home devices.
articles.body:
Smart homes, especially from lesser-known brands, have been a potential vector for hackers to launch cyberattacks across the web or gain unwanted network access for some time.

But artificial intelligence is adding a new wrinkle to the problem. According to research by Anthropic ( ANTH.PVT ), rogue AI models could soon be able to break into internet of things devices , ranging from smart stoves and TVs to intelligent refrigerators, and self-replicate across further gadgets.

Such models would be more difficult to shut down, because there's no central hub to take them offline. And while they may move slowly across devices, the company says the models can figure out how to propagate across devices they are unfamiliar with.

The announcement comes after Apple ( AAPL ) debuted its HomeView, putting the smart home market back into mainstream focus.

Anthropic performed its tests using Android-based devices.

It also follows a report that hackers broke into internet-connected refrigerators in French grocery stores, raising temperatures, ruining food, and starting fires.

During its own testing, Anthropic said it found that larger AI models can split themselves up and run across multiple devices. Some models also managed to pass knowledge to replicated versions of themselves, enabling them to adapt to different hardware.

"Machines that could run a significant model shard for a <30B model include smart fridges, smart ovens, automatic vacuum cleaners, and lawnmowers," the company said.

What's more, Anthropic notes, newer smart home devices are integrating AI chips to power their own AI models, giving attacking models more horsepower to continue spreading.

And thanks to their ability to run on different types of devices, they could eventually spread to increasingly powerful machines.

Anthropic says rogue replicators aren't a problem for now, since models under 30 billion parameters can complete individual steps in the replication process but make mistakes when running the entire chain of actions.

Still, the company says, at the current rate of model improvement, they may be able to reach such capabilities by the end of 2026.

Email Daniel Howley at dhowley@yahoofinance.com. Follow him on Twitter at @DanielHowley .

articles.title: 'Not a USA deal': Trump downplays Russian diesel plan in the face of GOP criticism
articles.summary: President Trump has begun to downplay his new deal with Russia after the plan to allow imports of Russian diesel into the US came under withering criticism.
articles.body:
President Trump has begun to downplay his new deal with Russia after a plan to allow imports of Russian diesel into the US came under withering criticism, even from members of his own party.

"It's a deal for the world ... It's not a deal with me," Trump told reporters on Tuesday morning, repeating that it was "not a USA deal."

"They're releasing it to the entire world," Trump added, after making similar comments on Monday that the deal would help US farmers, but said, "It's not really a deal with me, it's a deal for the rest of the world."

The contention is a marked shift since Trump announced the plans last week.

"I have just concluded a highly successful discussion with President Vladimir Putin, of Russia," he wrote on Truth Social , adding that it will be a "great announcement...for Americans and, indeed, the World."

The deal will include a quick release of 300,000 tons (about 2.2 million barrels) of diesel. That would then be followed by another 500,000 in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter" for a total of about 13.5 million barrels.

His administration quickly authorized US purchases of Russian diesel through next April.

Calls on the president to 'immediately reverse course'

Blowback to the plan has been notable — even within Trump's own party.

A bipartisan group of senators called on the president to "immediately reverse course," in a letter signed by Republican Sens. Susan Collins of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, Thom Tillis of North Carolina, and John Curtis of Utah, along with three Democrats.

The plan has also received a lukewarm reception on the midterm campaign trail, with figures like Republican Mike Rogers, who is locked in a tight Senate contest in Michigan, distancing himself from it .

Some energy experts suggest the deal might run afoul of US law, while others suggest it simply won't work since Russia seems to lack enough excess diesel refining capacity to markedly increase exports and move US or global diesel prices.

Indeed, the current average price of diesel, according to the American Automobile Association, was almost $6.28 per gallon on Tuesday, a tick up from almost $6.27 per gallon on Monday.

Wholesale diesel prices are "not blinking over Russia/US 'deal'" Patrick De Haan, the head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, noted on Tuesday . "Truckers and farmers not going to see any relief anytime soon."

But Trump continued to defend the deal and dodged a question about another major critique, which is that it could fund Russia's war efforts against Ukraine.

articles.title: High energy prices likely mean inflation is heating up. Will it push the Fed to hike this month?
articles.summary: Inflation likely accelerated last month due to higher energy prices, but core CPI may be more subdued.
articles.body:
Consumer Price Index data due out tomorrow will likely show that inflation heated up in September as energy prices rose.

Economists surveyed by Bloomberg expect a 3.6% jump in annual inflation, up from 3.4% in August. On a monthly basis, prices are expected to be up 0.6% in September from 0.4% a month earlier.

Gas prices are likely to be a particularly large contributor to September's inflation figures. Average prices at the pump hit a record $4.33 last month , according to AAA data, nearly $0.50 above the previous monthly record set in 2023.

What may look more subdued, however, is "core" inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy prices and is watched more closely by Federal Reserve officials. Economists expect core inflation to come in at 2.5% annually in September, a slight acceleration from 2.4% in August. Monthly core inflation is seen ticking down slightly to 0.2%, from August's higher-than-expected 0.3%.

"Wednesday's September Consumer Price Index report is expected to be a rather straightforward print, but no news is not necessarily good news when inflation remains elevated," Realtor.com senior economist Jake Krimmel said in a statement.

Core inflation in line with expectations will likely be enough to convince the Fed to hold rates steady at its Oct. 28 meeting. Following a so-so September jobs report and mixed commentary from Fed officials about the timing of future rate hikes , traders currently see a 76% chance that the central bank leaves rates unchanged this month.

But hotter-than-expected core inflation remains a real risk, many economists say. They point to factors like rising costs of certain core inputs, such as airfare, hotels, and auto parts. And the recent run-up in diesel prices can also flow through to the cost of goods.

"The risk remains that we see limited prospect of a material deceleration in core inflation, and September's CPI report won't fully capture the upside risks ahead," RBC economists led by Mike Reid wrote. And if core inflation stays elevated for a second month in a row, an October rate hike may be back in play.

"A 0.3% core CPI print would likely revive speculation that the Fed may need to continue its tightening cycle in [October]," Bank of America economist Stephen Juneau wrote in a note.

Claire Boston is a Senior Reporter for Yahoo Finance covering housing, mortgages, and home insurance.

articles.title: Bank of America hit with $1.2 billion penalty over money laundering failures
articles.summary: Regulators fined Bank of America (BAC) more than $1.2 billion on Tuesday, the third-largest fine in the Treasury Department's history.
articles.body:
Regulators fined Bank of America ( BAC ) more than $1.2 billion on Tuesday over widespread failures in the banking giant's safeguards against money laundering and other illicit financial activity.

The Treasury Department said the nation's second-largest bank failed to properly monitor trillions of dollars in transactions and to report more than $5 billion in suspicious activity, including transactions potentially tied to Chinese money-laundering networks, narcotics trafficking, and fraud.

The enforcement actions include a $1.2 billion penalty from the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), the third-largest fine in the Treasury Department's history after it fined crypto exchange Binance $3.4 billion in 2023 and TD Bank for $1.3 billion in 2024. The fine also includes a $750 million penalty from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the largest ever imposed by that regulator.

The OCC penalty will be credited against FinCEN's assessment rather than added to it. Separately, a $11.6 million sanctions settlement brings the total penalties to more than $1.21 billion.

"Even the biggest financial institutions are not above the law," Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement.

Bank of America's stock fell more than 2% after markets closed on Tuesday. It reports third quarter earnings Wednesday morning.

The bank said it will include a "non-tax-deductible charge of $1.2 billion impacting net income by approximately 17 cents per share" in its third quarter results.

"Financial crime compliance is serious, and we are responsible for getting it right," a Bank of America spokesperson said in an email statement, adding that the Charlotte, North Carolina based lender has invested "billions of dollars in technology" and dedicated "thousands of employees to combat financial crime" to resolve the deficiencies.

Regulators said Bank of America's failures extended across its transaction monitoring systems, customer due diligence, and internal oversight.

The bank failed to report more than $5 billion in suspicious transactions, including over $1 billion involving national security-related and other priority illicit finance risks.

FinCEN said Bank of America admitted to willfully violating the Bank Secrecy Act and had effectively outsourced substantial portions of its suspicious activity detection responsibilities to law enforcement and other financial institutions.

The bank also prioritized revenue over compliance resources, according to Treasury, allowing suspicious transactions to go uninvestigated for extended periods.

articles.title: Trump’s Russia Deal Is Too Small to Dent Diesel Prices
articles.summary: A US deal for Russian diesel is too limited to meaningfully move prices at the pumps ahead of November’s midterm elections, analysts say.
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- A US deal for Russian diesel is too limited to meaningfully move prices at the pumps ahead of November's midterm elections, analysts say.

US President Donald Trump is searching for a way to reduce sky-high diesel prices, with his Republican Party widely expected to lose seats in the Nov. 3 elections. He shocked some in his own party and European leaders with a deal last week to drop sanctions on Russia in exchange for diesel cargoes to address global shortages.

The first shipment, set for this month, is for around 2.25 million barrels, according to Trump. Moscow has pledged to release around 3.75 million barrels "at this stage," without saying when they will be sent or when additional shipments might be authorized. Even at the higher end of the estimate, if every barrel loaded onto a vessel headed for US shores, it would only cover just over a day's worth of US diesel demand.

"Trump is trying to push every lever he can to get this price down," said Joe DeLaura, global energy strategist at Rabobank. But the released product is "too little, too late and there isn't enough to do anything."

Trump is grappling with voter anger over rising diesel prices, which have been exacerbated by his war on Iran. Retail prices are at their highest ever seasonal level this late into the fall, during the crucial crop harvest season. The Russian deal has heightened tensions with Ukraine and seemingly does little to mitigate the risks for his party amid tight Senate races in agricultural states like Kansas, Iowa and Nebraska.

The White House has announced several measures in an attempt to lower fuel costs, including loosening regulations around a tax-free red-dyed variant of diesel, tapping the country's oil reserves and waiving a century-old shipping law. Potentially importing fuel from Russia is the latest effort, and perhaps the most controversial.

The decision abandons years of sanctions designed to limit Russia's ability to profit from exports and drew condemnations from the European Union and US lawmakers. Russia's last diesel shipment arrived on US shores in March 2022, according to data from the Energy Information Administration and corroborated by Bloomberg and Vortexa shipping data, the month after Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

articles.title: AI Selloff Drags Emerging Stocks Down, Weighs on Currency Gauge
articles.summary: The deepening selloff in shares linked to artificial intelligence dragged emerging-market equities down for their worst day since July.
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- The deepening selloff in shares linked to artificial intelligence dragged emerging-market equities down for their worst day since July.

MSCI's benchmark for developing-nations stocks fell 2.2% on Tuesday, weighed down by Asia, which makes up the bulk of the gauge. South Korea's Kospi Index posted its longest losing streak in 21 months, with chipmaker SK Hynix Inc. leading losses. Samsung Electronics Co. also fell.

Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT said it achieved a breakthrough in chip technology that rivals like Samsung had pursued for years. A poll by Bank of America Corp. showed global investors chasing the AI-powered equity rally are the most exposed to technology shares since the rebound from the Covid pandemic six years ago.

"The debate has shifted from simply how much AI spending will grow, to who will capture the benefits and whether valuations justify expected returns," according to Felipe Barragán, senior research strategist at Pepperstone.

The rout also fueled losses in the South Korean won and the Taiwanese dollar, which pushed the index tracking emerging-market currencies down 0.3%. The gauge was little changed after Fed Bank of New York President John Williams said he still sees one more hike as appropriate this year, but currently doesn't believe it will be necessary to lift rates again in 2027.

Currencies in Latin America were also broadly lower as trading restarted in most markets in the region after Monday holidays. The Chilean peso slid about 0.5%, while the Brazilian real declined 0.8%.

Meanwhile, the Indian rupee outperformed peers and extended this week's gains to 1.5% after the central bank widened curbs on certain types of derivative transactions to support the currency.

In credit markets, Senegal's year-end target to finalize a deal with the International Monetary Fund and reach a debt-relief agreement with bondholders is already facing delays.

With assistance from Karl Lester M. Yap and Jiyeun Lee.

articles.title: How phones on EMI are driving loan demand for two-wheelers
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Consumer durable loans, such as those for buying a mobile phone on EMI, are helping lenders build credit histories for younger borrowers,
articles.body: MUMBAI: Consumer durable loans, such as those for buying a mobile phone on EMI, are helping lenders build credit histories for younger borrowers, contributing to a decline in two-wheeler loan delinquencies to a seven-year low of 1.4% in June 2026 from 2.7% in June 2019, according to TransUnion Cibil.First-time borrowers accounted for 39% of two-wheeler loan originations in the first half of 2026, down 19 percentage points from pre-pandemic levels. Meanwhile, 43% of borrowers had more than two years of formal credit history, up from 27% in 2019. Another 18% had less than two years of credit history, indicating more than 60% of borrowers had an established credit record, according to TU Cibil's latest report, Shifting Gears 2026: Credit Drives Today's Mobility.Consumption-led borrowing has contributed to this shift. Nearly a third of two-wheeler borrowers had consumption credit products in their credit histories in the first half of 2026, up from 22% in the corresponding period of 2019. Consumer durable loans featured in the histories of 18% of borrowers and gold loans in 16%, credit cards in 12% and agriculture-related credit products in 8%.NBFCs held 73% of outstanding two-wheeler loans.You use AI every day. articles.title: Rivian spinoff Mind Robotics hires ex-Ford EV chief Doug Field
articles.summary: In a big coup for Mind Robotics, the industrial robotics startup spun out of Rivian announced it hired former Ford EV chief Doug Field as its president.
articles.body:
In a big coup for Mind Robotics, the industrial robotics startup spun out of Rivian ( RIVN ) announced it has hired former Ford ( F ) EV chief Doug Field as its president.

Ford announced Field's exit six months ago, and now Mind Robotics gets one of the auto industry's most experienced hardware engineers, who also cut his teeth at Tesla.

The hire comes as Mind attempts to harness AI trained on Rivian's factory floor into robots it can sell to the wider manufacturing world.

Field will oversee product, engineering, and operations and will work alongside Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe, who founded Mind and chairs its board, according to a press release on Tuesday. Mind didn't disclose his pay or start date.

This price reflects trading activity during the overnight session on the Blue Ocean ATS, available 8 PM to 4 AM ET, Sunday through Thursday, when regular markets are closed.

"Doug is a remarkable leader with a track record of delivering new technologies in successful products," Scaringe said in a statement. "He has an incredible ability to foster great teams that take on big, complex ideas."

Field's resume reads like a who's who of the biggest tech companies. He led Mac hardware engineering at Apple ( AAPL ), then ran engineering at Tesla ( TSLA ) as senior vice president and oversaw development of the Model 3. He later went back to Apple to lead its Special Projects Group, widely reported to be home to the company's secretive car effort, before rejoining Ford in 2021.

At Ford, Field rose to chief EV, digital and design officer, reporting to CEO Jim Farley. He was behind the skunkworks team that built the automaker's low-cost Universal EV platform . His exit came in a broader leadership shake-up that folded his team into a new product creation and industrialization organization under COO Kumar Galhotra.

"Integrating AI and robotics is one of the most important — and difficult — engineering challenges of our time," Field said in the statement. "I'm thrilled to join RJ in building a team, culture, and technology that will redefine what we can make in America."

Mind Robotics was founded last year and was first disclosed to Rivian in November. The startup is building AI foundation models, robots, and deployment infrastructure for industrial automation.

Rivian is its first customer and launch partner, giving Mind a high-volume factory where it can train and deploy its robots. Rivian also kept a minority stake in the company.

Mind has raised more than $1 billion, including a $500 million Series A co-led by Accel and Andreessen Horowitz in March, and a $400 million round led by Kleiner Perkins in May, which valued the company at more than $3 billion, per the Wall Street Journal .

articles.title: Treasury fines Bank of America $1.2B for violating money laundering, sanctions law
articles.summary: The Treasury Department on Tuesday announced it was fining Bank of America more than $1.2 billion for violating anti-money laundering and sanctions laws. The Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) fined Bank of America, the second-largest bank in the country, $1.2 billion for its failure to “mitigate and report priority national security risks,” the department…
articles.body:
The Treasury Department on Tuesday announced it was fining Bank of America more than $1.2 billion for violating anti-money laundering and sanctions laws.

The Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) fined Bank of America, the second-largest bank in the country, $1.2 billion for its failure to “mitigate and report priority national security risks,” the department said in a release .

Those risks include Chinese money laundering networks and “illicit finance along the southwest border,” the Treasury noted.

The fine includes a $750 million penalty by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) over Bank of America’s “ineffective” anti-money laundering compliance program.

The Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control also reached an $11.6 million settlement with the bank for its apparent violation of “numerous” sanctions programs, including on Iran , Russia , narcotics and “global terrorism.”

The $1.2 billion penalty is the third-largest in Treasury history, while the OCC’s fine is the largest in that bureau’s history, per the Treasury.

The Hill has reached out to a Bank of America spokesperson for comment.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in the release that financial institutions “are on the front lines of protecting our economic and national security.”

Bessent added, “When a bank of this size fails to meet its anti-money laundering and sanctions obligations, the consequences extend far beyond its own walls, exposing the entire U.S. financial system to significant illicit finance risks.

“Today’s actions send a clear message that even the biggest financial institutions are not above the law.”

A spokesperson for Bank of America said the company “worked with regulators to reach these penalty resolutions” and has “invested billions of dollars in technology and dedicated thousands of employees to combat financial crime.”

FinCEN’s investigation found that Bank of America “failed to timely report” more than $5 billion in suspicious transactions.

Roughly $1 billion of those transactions posed national security and illicit finance risks, including links to Chinese money laundering networks and potential money laundering “with a substantial nexus” to the southwest border.

Bank of America “prioritized its revenues” and “effectively outsourced” a large portion of its proactive detection and reporting obligations to third parties, the Treasury noted.

Earlier this year, Bank of America reported $31.6 billion in net revenue in the second quarter, up from $30.3 billion in quarter one and an increase of 15.3 percent relative to the first quarter of 2025.

The bank will report its earnings for the third quarter on Wednesday morning.

The OCC’s probe into Bank of America found that its “deficient” transaction monitoring system resulted in the financial institution failing to properly monitor “trillions of dollars” in transactions, the bureau noted in a release .

“Every year, [Bank of America] processes hundreds of trillions of dollars in transactions across the globe. It has a high, and increasing, risk profile for money laundering, terrorist financing and other illicit activities,” added Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould, who called Bank of America’s violations “unacceptable” and “egregious.”

Under its resolution with FinCEN, Bank of America admitted to violating anti-money laundering laws and agreed to work with a third party to identify and report suspicious transactions it previously did not detect.

articles.title: Rollout of BS-VII in 3 phases from April 2029 to April 2035
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Govt is all set to roll out BS-VII emission standards, aligned with Euro 7 norms, in phases, starting April 2029.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Govt is all set to roll out BS-VII emission standards, aligned with Euro 7 norms, in phases, starting April 2029. The new norms will set stricter limits on harmful pollutants, including nitrogen oxides, hydrocarbons and particulate matter amid heightened pollution risks across Indian cities.BS-VII will start with new cars and SUVs manufactured from April 2029, followed by small goods delivery and pick-up vans from 2030 and buses and heavy-duty vehicles from April 2031. The new norms for two-wheelers - the biggest contributor to pollution - will, however, be notified later.Unlike BS-VI, which was first rolled out from April 2020, it will not require changes in the refinery infrastructure to produce petrol and diesel suitable for the upgraded emission standards, officials said. It will, however, require the automobile sector to upgrade engines.TOI has learnt that the road transport ministry has approved the proposed timeline, and draft notifications for the three categories of vehicles are expected over the next few days. The proposed emission norms will not affect existing vehicles or their life, including those compliant with BS-VI standards.The proposed standards will strengthen emissions monitoring beyond controlled laboratory tests to ensure vehicles comply with prescribed limits under real-world driving conditions and throughout their operational life. The implementation of all the new norms will be in three phases spanning six years - April 2029 to April 2035 - giving adequate time to industry and testing agencies.According to the finalised norms, the cut-off limits of various emission components for cars and SUVs remain unchanged compared with BS-VI. Particulate number has, however, been reduced fr-om 23 nanometres to 10 nanometres, resulting in improved filtration of pollutants. Smaller particles penetrate deeper into lungs. A person aware of the matter said the proposed change makes the regulation more stringent by capturing ultrafine particles, which have been unregulated thus far.The transition from BS-VI to BS-VII will have more impact on trucks and heavy-duty vehicles, with the proposed standard aimed at reducing emissions in the range of 20-50% across pollutants. This will be more stringent for on-road emissions.People involved in framing the norms said BS-VII goes beyond tailpipe emission by regulating non-exhaust sources such as brake wear and tyre abrasion. Moreover, the new norms will introduce the concept of market surveillance, where independent testing agencies will conduct in-use compliance checks.Officials said the norms are fully aligned with Euro 7 and its implementation, which was also structured in a phased manner, starting Nov 2026 for light-duty vehicles and May 2028 for heavy-duty vehicles. The full rollout will extend up to 2035.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: WWE Power Rankings after Monday Night RAW in Bossier City, LA
articles.summary: Ranking the top men's wrestlers in the WWE.
articles.body:
Hello everybody, and welcome back to another week of the WWE 's Men's Power Rankings. With Money in the Bank now in the past, I want to give congratulations to Tiffany Stratton and Penta for winning their respective matches on Saturday.

That means we now look forward to Survivor Series, which of course is War Games again this year. So over the next few weeks, you'll see cliques made to fill the match for this brawl that happens near Thanksgiving every year.

That being said, let's get to this week's list and see how these stories have unfolded since last week. Have a great day, everyone, and may the slams be with you.

Feb 1, 2025; Indianapolis, IN, USA; Chad Gable during the Men's Royal Rumble match during the WWE Royal Rumble at Lucas Oil Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Joe Camporeale-Imagn Images Credit: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

Chad Gable defeated Rey Fenix on Monday Night RAW via submission to retain the Intercontinental Championship. Their match was wrestled amazingly, showing why the WWE Universe, and even myself, finally believe in Gable. However, Gable dropped to tenth on this list after Penta's performance at MITB.

Trick Williams fought hard in last weekend's MITB match, in which Penta ended up winning. Since Williams is currently the U.S. Champion, I could see a storyline where he defends his title before Survivor Series, since the War Games matches usually run an hour. That could happen at Crown Jewel in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on November 7th.

Solo Sikoa, Jey Uso and Jimmy Uso wrestled in a six-man tag team match against 946 on RAW last night. The match went exactly the way you would expect it to go, with constant brawls outside the ring, leading to a no-contest. This storyline has been going on for quite some time, but now that War Games is in the future, you can bet this feud is about to heat up. YEET!

Penta won the Money in the Bank match, giving him the right to a title fight at any given moment. This is something I could see Penta using against Sami Zayn, who is the more beatable of the two champs. Of course, the element of surprise has always played a huge factor when people cash in their briefcase. This has led to a new champion on many different occasions, making Penta even more deadly than he already is. On RAW, Penta and Je'Von Evans went back and forth on the mic, showing off Penta's versatility, all around. For that, Penta moves up to number seven on this list.

Seth "Freakin" Rollins slips to fifth on this list after losing to Roman Reigns in the Main Event at SummerSlam. Since then, Rollins has cut some promos and gone face to face with a few wrestlers, but hasn't been b on T.V. for a minute. That's okay because he's really not needed right now, and we'll see if he shows up next week.

Rusev, left, wrestles Oba Femi during WWE Friday Night SmackDown at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, Friday, July 10, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

Oba Femi defeated Bronson Reed this weekend in one of the few matches that wasn't a Money in the Bank match. The match was spectacular and showed off Reed's in-ring skill perfectly. Even though Femi is the future of the WWE, Reed is going to be just as popular as a heel. On RAW, Femi cut a promo against Paul Heyman and simply sparked him on the mic.

C.M. Punk ended up losing in the MITB match on Saturday, in the main event. Even though Penta won, Punk was almost v up that ladder multiple times, and even looked to be the favorite late, because of this. Punk still looked strong in this match and wasn't on RAW last night, which means they're giving him some time to heal up, especially after some of the bumps he took in that match.

Sami Zayn came out on Friday Night SmackDown to cut a promo about being a good guy. After ranting for a few moments, Je'Von Evans came out to try to reason with Zayn, even though he felt Zayn was crashing out. There were a few more wrestlers that came out, but in the end, Zayn stormed out like a little child again.

Cody Rhodes decided to break character with Seth Rollins at a Street Fighter premiere this weekend, with a hug. Both wrestlers attended the premiere, enjoying some time off while the rest of the roster took care of business at MITB. Now that's done, Rhodes should be back in Smackdown this week, unless he has more obligations to hold up on the Hollywood side of things.

Roman Reigns defeated L.A. Knight in the opening match at Money in the Bank on Saturday. From high spots to false finishes, both superstars balled out until the OTC raised his finger in the end. Now that Knight has acknowledged our champion, we shall see what's next for our Tribal Chief.
